select cls,
  (fished_date_doy/10)::int*10 as bucket,
  sum(yt) as yt_sum,
  sum(anglers) as anglers_sum,
  round(sum(yt)/nullif(sum(anglers),0),3) as ypa,
  count(*) as n
from trips
where fished_date_season=6 and fished_date_doy between 300 and 340
  and cls in ('DAY_1_5','THREE_QUARTER','OVERNIGHT')
group by 1,2
order by 1,2

select max(fished_date_doy) as max_doy, count(*) as n
from trips where fished_date_season=6
select distinct cls from trips limit 20

select cls,
  (fished_date_doy/10)::int*10 as bucket,
  sum(yt) as yt_sum,
  sum(anglers) as anglers_sum,
  round(sum(yt)/nullif(sum(anglers),0),3) as ypa,
  count(*) as n
from trips
where fished_date_season=6 and fished_date_doy between 295 and 340
  and cls in ('day_1_5','three_quarter','overnight')
group by 1,2
order by 1,2
